author: Claude (independent verification track)
scope: Q2 / Area-A. Residual fetched by Round-80 provenance from stored checkpoints; no frontier replay, no path search.

engine_semantics.registration: extend() sets om[q] |= 1<<phase whenever move.weight >= 2; a weight-1 rotation never registers. initial_state registers its endpoint.
engine_semantics.abandonment: abandonment = not state.visited(word_after(p, SIGMA)), evaluated at the pre-joint endpoint p' and only for weight >= 2
engine_semantics.fragment: f1_normal_form's fragment_hex -- the unique non-current partially visited hexagon. It is created by an abandonment (F: 0->1) and repaired when a later joint re-enters it and the pass fills it. Distinct from Ndef.
engine_semantics.Ndef: Ndef = S + F - O, with dS = int(weight>=3), dF = int(abandonment), dO = int(new_orbit); so dNdef = dS + dF - dO
engine_semantics.R_vs_Z: R = weight-3 into an already-open orbit (dNdef = +1); Z3 = weight-3 into a fresh orbit (dNdef = 0); Z2 = weight-2 into an already-open orbit (dNdef = 0)

blocked_w2_lemma.status: PROVED (HP) -- previously cited from prior work and explicitly recorded in src/analyze_j_completion.py as 'a bounded empirical check, not a proof'
blocked_w2_lemma.why_it_matters: area_a_prune_reason's N_exceeded_monotone is Q1-SAFE and used by every search in the repo; its soundness needs dNdef >= 0, which needs exactly this lemma
blocked_w2_lemma.geometric_fact: for every one of the 720 words and all 6 rotation lengths, the w2 joint target t and the blocking window sigma(p') lie in the SAME E-orbit with t exactly one phase past the blocker: t = E(sigma(p')). 720 x 6 = 4,320 cases, 0 exceptions.
blocked_w2_lemma.proof: A window becomes visited in exactly three ways: as a joint target (weight >= 2, hence REGISTERED), as the initial endpoint (registered), or as a rotation target. A rotation reaches blocker = sigma(p') only from p'. By the no-repeat rule p' is visited exactly once, and that visit is the current one at the end of the current rotation run, which has not gone past p'. So a visited blocker cannot have been rotation-visited, hence it is registered. The blocker is a port of the target's orbit, so that orbit already holds a registered port and new_orbit is False. At ell = 5 the blocker is p itself -- the pass entry, a joint target -- which is also why E^1 preserves the orbit. QED
blocked_w2_lemma.computational_confirmation: the forbidden row (weight 2, abandonment False, new_orbit True) occurs 0 times among 2,647,483 macro edges over 120,000 expanded nodes -- and 0 times even among PRUNED transitions, so it is absent structurally rather than filtered
blocked_w2_lemma.consequence: dNdef >= 0 for every legal macro joint; Ndef is monotone non-decreasing; N_exceeded_monotone is sound

stage_B_minimum_unavoidable_defect_count.consequence_of_F_equals_1: every residual state has F = 1, so no further abandonment is legal (F_exceeded). Combined with the blocked-w2 lemma, the remaining joint alphabet is exactly {rotation, Z2 (w2 -> open, dNdef 0), Z3 (w3 -> fresh, dNdef 0), R (w3 -> open, dNdef +1)}.
stage_B_minimum_unavoidable_defect_count.no_new_fragment_can_be_created: fragment creation requires an abandonment, which requires F budget, which is exhausted. So there is no fragment-creation obligation to charge at all; the single existing fragment is the unique doubly-passed hexagon already accounted for by the Round-77/78 collision and cover machinery.
stage_B_minimum_unavoidable_defect_count.zero_defect_openings: Z3 opens a fresh orbit at dNdef = 0, and all 144 orbits admit a Z3 opening (each from 56 distinct source orbits, over-approximated over all words, rotation lengths and w3 joints)
stage_B_minimum_unavoidable_defect_count.result: M_def = 0 for all 6,657 states: every cover candidate has a zero-defect opening available

stage_C_repair_supply: NOT ATTEMPTED -- the payoff gate stops the round when every state has a cover solution with zero unavoidable defect creation, which it does

adversarial_checks.weight2_fresh_orbit_without_abandonment: searched for explicitly; 0 occurrences in 2.6M macro edges, and now proved impossible rather than merely unobserved
adversarial_checks.negative_dNdef_rows: the taxonomy shows (2, False, True) is the ONLY negative row; it is exactly the forbidden one
adversarial_checks.e1_e2_interaction: E^1 is the ell = 5 instance of the Z2 row (dNdef = 0) and E^2 the ell = 5 instance of the R row (dNdef = +1); neither can create or repair a fragment, since neither abandons

diagnostics.minimum_unavoidable_defect_count: 0 for every state, in every c band
